COD.note: Document does not mention the central bank.
Document states no consumer-protection rules or complaints body.
Document does not mention cross-border payments.
Veri-Gov is a provincial tax payment platform, not a national portal service.
Document describes payments to government, not to people.
Document gives no account-ownership survey figure.
Document names no mobile money provider or retail payment service.

facts.fact: Tshopo provincial government officially launched Veri-Gov on 21 August 2026 in Kisangani, a platform for paying provincial taxes and revenues electronically by mobile phone, per Opinion Info.
